Title: Automated key rotation in Azure Key Vault is now in public preview

Body.Content:
With the Azure Key Vault automated key rotation feature, now in public preview, you can set a rotation policy on a key to schedule automated rotation and configure expiry notifications through Event Grid integration.

This feature enables end-to-end zero-touch key rotation for Azure services data encryption with customer-managed key (CMK) stored in Azure Key Vault.

Learn more.
